idea: Colors & shapes (KITCHEN, snack time): a big round cookie rolls across Baby Jimmy's high-chair tray by surprise ('Wow! Look! A circle!'); he traces it 'round and round' (copy-me: draw a circle in the air); then a yellow cheese SQUARE ('one, two, three, four sides!') and a sandwich TRIANGLE ('one, two, three sides!'); all three stand in a row and Jimmy asks the viewer 'Where is the triangle? Hmm?' (pause) – 'There it is!'; lesson 'Shapes are everywhere!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now with all three shapes in a row and a bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! A Circle Cookie! 🍪 Learn Shapes with Baby Jimmy | Shapes for Toddlers | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A big round cookie rolls right up to Baby Jimmy at snack time! 🍪 Jimmy finds a circle, a square and a triangle in his snacks – sing along and learn your shapes with him!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A circle!" – a round cookie rolls in
⭕ Circle, circle, round and round – draw a circle in the air with Jimmy!
🧀 A yellow cheese square – one, two, three, four sides!
🥪 A sandwich triangle – one, two, three sides!
🤔 "Where is the triangle?" – can you find it?
👋 Shapes are everywhere! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: shapes for toddlers • circle, square, triangle • a square has four sides, a triangle has three sides • English words: circle, square, triangle, shapes

A fun sing-along cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about basic shapes, with Baby Jimmy finding a circle, a square and a triangle in everyday snacks.

Kids cartoon • Shapes song for kids • Learn shapes • Nursery rhymes • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning • Preschool learning
